en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a tree‑lined avenue with elegant multi‑storey residential buildings on the left and right, distant hills in the background, and a horse‑drawn carriage on an unpaved road. The left side contains the photograph, while the right side and lower margin are filled with dense handwritten text. Printed caption at the bottom identifies the scene and location.
